full_name: Robin Bernstein | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Humanities Joy Foundation Fellow Harvard University
bio: During her fellowship year, Robin Bernstein is writing a narrative history of a mass murder that occurred in 1846 just outside of Auburn, New York. This true crime opens a window onto a 19th-century North in which slavery and abolition entangled lethally with an emerging form of unfreedom: convict labor.
